Status.description_en:
The operational status of the instance. Valid values:

`Preparing`: The instance is being initialized.

`Rebooting`: The instance is rebooting.

`Resetting`: The instance is being reset.

`Working`: The instance is running normally. This is a terminal state.

`Failure`: The instance has failed to start or operate. This is a terminal state
Status.description_zh:
实例操作状态，取值范围，
Preparing：初始化准备中
Rebooting：重启中
Resetting：重置中
Working：工作中，属于终态
Failure：操作失败，属于终态
